name: chart-radial
title: Radial Chart
description: Three radial cards: a near-full ring, a half-circle gauge and a set of concentric browser bands, each with a large total in the middle and a footer trend line.
use: A single headline figure on a dashboard where a ring or gauge shows proportion instantly.
avoid: Comparing many categories precisely: thin rings and tiny inner labels read worse than bars or a table.
a11y: Tooltips need a mouse; keyboard users cannot inspect the values and no text alternative lists the numbers. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three dark rounded cards in a row. The left holds a hollow ring around a bold 200 and the word Visitors; the middle holds a half-circle gauge around 1,830 Visitors; the right packs several thin concentric rings with small browser names. Each card ends in a footer trend line and a caption.
behaves: The arcs hold still. Hovering a ring or gauge raises a small dark tooltip naming the series and its visitor count, which is the only change across the frames.
customise: Each variant writes its data, centre total and footer copy into the file, so changes need a source edit; colours come from the shared chart CSS variables.
weight: light: A few SVG arcs and labels per card; only a hover triggers a redraw.
demo: Titles Text, Stacked and Label; centre figures 200 and 1,830 with Visitors; footer reads Trending up by 5.2% this month.
issues: Browser names inside the thin rings are very small and low contrast on the dark card.
polishWhy: Tidy default chart cards; the dense label ring and small grey text are unremarkable.
